notes:
- Company: SourceWise Integrations — developer platform that ships IDE plugins for enterprise engineering teams.
- Primary ask: repo-aware context retrieval for IDE copilot; must be low-latency (hosted or VPC) and satisfy residency for customer repos.
- Workload: streaming completions in-editor + asynchronous code search/embeddings for context. Typical session: 3–7 open files, 1–3 simultaneous users per seat in some teams.
- Latency targets: 50–120ms per token for interactive completion stream; 200ms cold-start search roundtrip for top-k repo retrieval.
- Throughput: bursts during onboarding; baseline 200 qps at seed customers.
- Embeddings strategy discussed: per-repo indexes, chunked at function/class granularity with token budget 512–1024, overlap 50–200 tokens, HTML/MD/text handled separately. Prefer code-specific embedding model.
- Vector DB: preference for self-hosted pgvector or Milvus in VPC; requirement: index data must remain in customer's VPC/region. Asked about Redwood-managed index with encryption at rest — security didn't like.
- Model/version pinning: want ability to pin particular quantized model (e.g., llama-3-70b-8bit / custom quant) per workspace; automatic fallbacks to smaller model under load.
- Caching: KV cache reuse between consecutive completions, prefix caching across time-window, per-repo LRU cache for embeddings.
- Routing policy: low-latency routing to local region, fall back to smaller model in central region if capacity constrained; need SLOs for golden path.
- Observability: token-level latency + cost per completion, per-repo retrieval hit-rate, model-rollout regressions tied to prompt set.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs, customer KMS, retention policies (90–365d configurable), evidence for SOC2 required.
- Quote from lead eng: "Can't ship without repo residency and deterministic model pins — experimental changes break IDE UX."
- Recent timeline: 2025-02-14 discovery call (intro + product fit); 2025-02-18 technical deep-dive (SE + infra) — discussed chunking/embeddings; 2025-02-20 security briefing with security team (Fireflies ff_20250220_8793); 2025-02-26 demo of streaming POC in hosted env (latency miss on 70b quant) — agreed POC in VPC.
- POC plan: 2-week VPC pilot, ingest 10 repos, build per-repo vector indexes (pgvector), run real IDE plugin traces, measure token latency and retrieval precision, do 1 canary rollout with model pinning.
- Risks: model licensing for quantized weights, vector DB ops burden, initial latency on 70b quant; possible workaround: use 13B optimized variant for live traffic.
- Next actions (short): finalize NDA, deliver VPC onboarding doc, schedule infra access (IAM roles), SE to supply chunking script and embedding params, legal to confirm model license.
